Onyeka Okongwu scored the Hawks' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 19 times in 69 starts, or 28% of the games they started. Nickeil Alexander-Walker was next with 14. The Hawks made the game's first field goal in 45% of their 88 games and won 49% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
